Ollama is a tool for running large language models locally on consumer hardware. It supports models like Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, and Nomic Embed Text for embeddings. Models are distributed as GGUF files and run efficiently on CPU, Apple Silicon, and NVIDIA GPUs through llama.cpp. Ollama provides a REST API for embeddings and chat completions. It is commonly used for local AI prototyping, offline RAG systems, and privacy-sensitive applications where data must not leave the device. The API endpoints include /api/embeddings for vector generation and /api/chat for text completion.
